nodes.description: GoogleVerse constructor initializes owner, supply, router, pair, fees and bots
renounceOwnership onlyOwner sets owner to zero
Internal transfer with fee, limit, blacklist and swap logic
Swaps contract tokens for ETH through Uniswap router
Sends ETH to development and marketing addresses
setTrading onlyOwner enables trading and sets launchBlock
manualswap restricted to dev/marketing performs token swap
manualsend restricted to dev/marketing sends contract ETH
blockBots onlyOwner adds addresses to blacklist
unblockBot onlyOwner removes address from blacklist
Internal token transfer handling fee removal/restoration
Internal standard transfer updates reflection balances
setFee onlyOwner updates buy/sell fee rates
Internal converts reflection amount to token amount
